notes.title: Major Update and Halloween
notes.content:
[b]A completely new game is already here. The game has changed the gameplay and plot.[/b]

The plot has been divided into chapters, and now you can get even more scared in the game.

Now you can play scared more than you expect.

[i]Am waiting for your assessment, comments and suggestions on the next chapter.[/i]

notes.title: Correction
notes.content:
List of corrections:

[list]
[*]Selected items are highlighted
[*]In the second level on the stairs the main character does not get stuck
[*]In the main menu, a warning has been added that "you need to turn up the sound before starting the game"
[*]Interaction with objects is now further than it was before the update
[/list]
